title: The Righteous Will Shine Like the Sun
story:
A little girl loved looking at the night sky with her grandfather.

One evening, they sat outside and watched the stars appearing one by one.

The girl asked, "Grandpa, why can we see the stars so clearly at night?"

He smiled and explained that darkness makes the light of the stars easier to notice.

He then told her that our lives can sometimes feel like that too.

There may be difficult days when the world around us seems filled with darkness, injustice, sadness, and confusion.

At times, we may wonder why good people suffer or why evil seems to succeed.

But Jesus reminds us that darkness will not have the final word.

There is a day when God will make all things right, and those who belong to Him will shine brightly in His kingdom.

Until that day, God calls us to remain faithful and to live as people who reflect His light.

We may not always see the results of doing what is right.

Our kindness may go unnoticed, our faithfulness may not be praised, and our prayers may seem unanswered.

But God sees every act of obedience and every heart that seeks Him.

The promise of God's kingdom gives us courage to keep doing what is right even when the world around us is difficult.

So do not let darkness make you give up.

Continue to walk in God's ways, love others, forgive, speak truth, and remain faithful.

A day is coming when God's light will shine fully, and those who belong to Him will shine with Him.
life_lesson: Even when the world seems dark or evil appears to succeed, remain faithful to God. He promises a future where His people will shine in His kingdom.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for the promise of Your eternal kingdom.

When I see darkness, injustice, or suffering around me, help me not to lose hope.

Give me strength to remain faithful and to continue doing what is right.

Help me reflect Your light through my words, choices, kindness, and actions.

When my efforts go unnoticed, remind me that You see and value every act of faithfulness.

Keep my heart focused on the hope of the future You have prepared for those who love You.

Help me live today in a way that honors You and points others toward Your light.

May I remain faithful until the day I shine with You in Your kingdom.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are there situations around you that make you feel discouraged or cause you to question whether doing what is right matters?

How can you reflect God's light through your actions today?

Are you keeping your hope focused on God's promises even when life feels difficult?
verse: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Whoever has ears, let them hear.
